pages.title: Collect the patterns
pages.text: Blueprint Storage holds six blueprints for a directly adjacent Constructor or Auto Constructor; any face works. A populated blueprint shows its result and ingredients. Blank blueprints teach no recipe.$(br2)The upper slots show stored patterns. The lower grid shows your whole inventory, with a separated hotbar. Blueprints are bright; other items are dimmed and cannot be selected or transferred. Double-click a slot to transfer, or select one and use the up/down arrows. Patterns stay in storage after crafting. Keep useful blueprints from your travels.
This starter library uses ordinary crafting. Marble colors may be mixed. You do not need an existing library to make it.

pages.title: Load your library
pages.text: Open Blueprint Storage and double-click its displayed slots to transfer blueprints between it and your inventory.$(br2)Blueprints stay in the library after crafting. Add more adjacent storage blocks for more patterns.$(br2)If you use JEI, look up a Constructor recipe to see its blueprint, ingredients and full output.
